source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.2 with Figs. 5.1 and 5.2 (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Agar hum naram rubber ki gend haath mein le kar dabayein to gend ki shakal ya volume badal jata hai; dabana band kar ke haath kholein to gend apni asal gol shakal par wapas aa jati hai (Fig. 5.1). Isi tarah agar hum rubber ki dori ke do siron ko pakar kar haath door karein to hamare haathon ki force se dori ki lambai barhti hai, aur lagai force jitni zyada, lambai mein utna zyada izafa; force hatane par dori apni asal lambai par wapas aati hai. In misalon se nateeja nikalta hai ke bigaar, yani shakal, lambai ya volume mein tabdeeli, tab paida hoti hai jab jism par koi bahri force lage.

blocks.title: Elasticity
blocks.text: Crystalline solids mein atoms aam taur par ek khaas tarteeb mein hote hain aur inter-atomic cohesive force unhen apni tawazun (equilibrium) ki jagahon ke gird rakhti hai. Bahri force ke tahat bigaar is liye hota hai ke atoms apni tawazun ki jagahon se hat jate hain, aur jism stress ki halat mein kaha jata hai. Bahri force hatane ke baad atoms apni tawazun ki jagahon par wapas aate hain aur jism apni asal shakal dobara pa leta hai, basharte lagai force bohat zyada na ho. Jism ki apni asal shakal par wapas aane ki salahiyat elasticity kehlati hai. Fig. 5.2 bahri force ke tahat crystal ke unit cell ka bigaar dikhati hai: baghair kheenche, bahar ki taraf kheenchne wali force ke tahat, andar ki taraf lagi force ke tahat, aur force hatane ke baad.

blocks.caption: Bigaar
rows: atoms tawazun se hate hue (stress ki halat)
atoms wapas, agar force bohat zyada na thi

blocks.prompt: Steel ki chhari aur rubber band par ek jaisi force lagti hai; kaun sa zyada khinchta hai, aur kaun sa zyada elastic hai (Brain Teaser; MCQ 5.2)?
blocks.explanation: Rubber band kahin zyada khinchta hai, kyunke us ka Young's modulus steel ke muqable bohat chhota hai. Physics mein elasticity asal shakal dobara pane ki salahiyat hai, jo is se napi jati hai ke kisi strain ke liye kitna stress chahiye, to steel, bare modulus ke saath, zyada elastic material hai.

items: Bigaar (shakal, lambai ya volume ki tabdeeli) bahri force se paida hota hai; atoms tawazun se hatte hain (stress ki halat) aur force hatane par wapas aate hain, agar woh bohat zyada na thi: elasticity.
